cards.src: Hagia Sophia: its dome's crown ~94 m ASL (ground ~38 m + 55.6 m). Painted (Grok Imagine) from the photo '20131205 Istanbul 270' by Mark Ahsmann, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
The Blue Mosque: its minarets' tips ~100 m ASL (ground ~36 m + 64 m). Painted (Grok Imagine) from the photo '20131205 Istanbul 270' by Mark Ahsmann, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
The Beyazıt Tower: its tip ~148 m ASL (ground ~63 m + 85 m). Painted (Grok Imagine) from the photo 'Eminönü iskele - panoramio' by Aziz Akbiyik, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
The Golden Horn Metro Bridge (pylons ~65 m ASL) with the Atatürk Bridge behind it. Painted (Grok Imagine) from the photo 'Golden Horn Metro Bridge 8458' by Dosseman, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
Kız Kulesi (its cone's top ~25 m ASL) before Üsküdar's and Harem's shore. Painted (Grok Imagine) from the photo 'Kız Kulesi, Mädchenturm - panoramio (1)' by qwesy qwesy, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0
